faqs.q: Why does Toast show both venue names?
faqs.a: Cococabana and The Lobby Tiki Bar share this Toast gift-card checkout. The purchase page is titled “The Lobby Tiki Bar/CocoCabana Gift Card,” so you are in the right place.

faqs.q: Can I send the gift card by email or text?
faqs.a: Yes. Toast offers email, text and delivery to yourself first, with a personal message. Choose today or a later delivery date during checkout.

faqs.q: How do I check my gift card balance?
faqs.a: Use the Check Gift Card Balance link to open the shared Toast balance form. Have your gift card details ready.

faqs.q: Does buying a gift card reserve a table?
faqs.a: No. Gift cards and reservations are separate. Check current menus, hours and event details when arranging your visit.
